events.title: Recovery proposed
events.detail: Checkout fails due to payments' strict_currency_validation rejecting legacy currency strings. Payments v2.4 is compatible with ledger schema 2, but still enforces strict validation. Disabling the runtime flag allows legacy currency acceptance without rollback. Inventory and ledger remain healthy. Storefront failure is mediated through checkout. Full dependency chain confirms no upstream service failure; the issue is a configuration mismatch in payments. Rollback is blocked by ledger schema 2. The flag disable is permitted by current policy and does not require rollback. Probing confirms all services are responsive except payments and checkout, with storefront failure stemming from checkout dependency chain.

data.title: Payments v2.4 release record
data.text: Payments v2.4 enabled strict_currency_validation. Checkout still sends legacy currency strings. The previous v2.3 release predates ledger schema 2. Both rollback and a runtime flag change require the current compatibility advisory.

data.title: INC-1988 · historical recovery
data.text: Last month payments validation errors were resolved by rolling back to v2.3. That incident used ledger schema 1. This is historical evidence, not proof of current compatibility. Verify the ledger schema before rollback.

data.title: Payments runtime configuration
data.text: strict_currency_validation=true. Toggle is scoped to payments. Disabling it restores acceptance of legacy currency strings, but requires a current safety advisory. Verify downstream checkout and storefront probes after any change.

data.title: Last received ledger compatibility advisory
data.text: The last received signed advisory reports ledger schema 1 as of 08:00 UTC. It permits rollback to payments v2.3. A flag-only mitigation has not been approved in this advisory. A later schema migration may supersede this record; runtime preconditions are checked again before any action executes.

policies.reason: The last received schema 1 advisory permits payments v2.3 rollback.
A flag-only mitigation requires an updated ledger safety advisory.

data.title: Ledger migration · schema 2 is active
data.text: Ledger schema 2 became active at 08:55 UTC. Payments v2.3 is incompatible with schema 2. Rollback to v2.3 is blocked. Payments v2.4 supports schema 2; its currency flag can be disabled without rolling back. This supersedes assumptions made in INC-1988.

policies.reason: Ledger schema 2 blocks payments v2.3. The old rollback procedure is incompatible.
The schema 2 advisory permits disabling validation while retaining payments v2.4.
